summary: Firefox expanded hardware media support, especially Linux Vulkan Video decoding through FFmpeg, with better device reuse, DMA-BUF/EGL interoperability, NVIDIA safeguards, and broader Nightly coverage. Video color information, HDR formats, AV1 temporal layers, and encoder metadata are now preserved more reliably across decoding and encoding, while Apple VideoToolbox and Windows Media Foundation state handling was hardened. **Protected media activation now requests the needed input trust authority for clear lead video streams**, with a preference to disable recovery when necessary; _the new behavior is off by default_.
